subject: Renewal + Capacity Add-on: Invoice channel reassignment and PO split
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novagrid.com>, Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@novagrid.com>
Cc: procure@novagrid.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Capacity Add-on: Invoice channel reassignment and PO split

Hi Elena / Michael,

Congrats on approving the renewal — excited to get the capacity add-on live. Two quick billing asks to make sure invoices flow to the right teams on your side:

1) We need two separate POs: one for NovaGrid US (EIN: 12-3456789) and a second for NovaGrid OpenCloud (EIN: 98-7654321). The commitment in the quote is split 70% / 30% respectively. Can your procurement team issue two POs with those allocations?

2) Invoice channel reassignment: please confirm the billing recipient(s) for each PO. We typically send PDF invoices to invoice@novagrid-payments.com and route AR remittance to finance@novagrid.com. If you want different targets, let us know — we can create two invoice channels and pin Net45 terms for this renewal.

Attached: renewal_quote_DEAL-4491.pdf (commitment + breakout) and W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf.

If you can confirm by end of week, Jordan (cc’d) will prepare the split invoices and we’ll generate two distinct invoice channels in our system.

Next steps I suggest:
- Procurement: issue two POs (PO numbers preferred)
- Finance: confirm invoice recipients and whether a consolidated remittance address is desired

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Ruiz, Elena <elena.ruiz@novagrid.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity Add-On: Invoice channel reassignment and PO split

Thanks Sofia — and great to move forward. Quick answers from procurement/finance: 

- Procurement will issue two POs. Expect PO-NG-US-7721 and PO-NG-OC-7722 by tomorrow EOD.
- Confirmed EINs are correct for billing.
- Please issue invoices to the following recipients for each PO: 
  * PO-NG-US-7721 → invoices-us@novagrid-payments.com (AP team)
  * PO-NG-OC-7722 → invoices-cloud@novagrid-payments.com (Cloud finance team)
- Remittance will be consolidated to treasury@novagrid.com — they will provide the bank remit instructions once they receive the two PDF invoices.

Two additional asks from our side: 
1) Can Redwood set Net45 for both invoice channels for this renewal period? We prefer the extended term for this contract year.
2) For internal audit, can you attach a copy of Redwood’s W-9 to each invoice PDF (we saw the file you attached to the email, that should be sufficient).

I’ll loop procurement on the POs. cc’d Michael to confirm remittance routing.

Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations
NovaGrid

Jordan / Marissa — forwarding NovaGrid confirmation. Procurement will issue two POs (PO-NG-US-7721 and PO-NG-OC-7722). Requirements:

- Create two invoice channels in our billing system: invoices-us@novagrid-payments.com and invoices-cloud@novagrid-payments.com. Pin Net45 for both channels for this contract year.
- Attach W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf to each generated invoice PDF (Elena requested it for audit).
- Use breakout in renewal_quote_DEAL-4491.pdf for 70% / 30% split across PO-NG-US-7721 / PO-NG-OC-7722.
- Route remittance field on both invoices to treasury@novagrid.com and include note: "Remittance instructions to follow from NovaGrid treasury."

Also — please update HubSpot deal DEAL-4491 with the two PO numbers and mark billing status as "Split PO - pending remit." Link below.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4491 
Invoice preview URL (internal): https://app.redwoodinference.com/invoices/preview/4491

Let me know if you need anything else before I ask procurement to deliver signed POs.

Best,
Sofia

Thanks — we’ll take this on. Action items we will complete today: 

1) Create two invoice channels and set payment terms to Net45. Channels: invoices-us@novagrid-payments.com and invoices-cloud@novagrid-payments.com.
2) Generate two invoice PDFs using the 70% / 30% split and attach W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf to each invoice. Invoice IDs: RWI-4491-US-001 and RWI-4491-OC-002.
3) Update HubSpot DEAL-4491 with PO-NG-US-7721 and PO-NG-OC-7722 and set billing status to "Split PO - pending remit."
4) Email the two invoice PDFs to the AP recipients Elena confirmed and cc treasury@novagrid.com for remittance.

Marissa — can you please push the invoices through our PDF generator and confirm the bank remit note is visible in the invoice footer? I’ll schedule the emails once you confirm.

Elena / Michael — once we send the PDFs, please confirm receipt and that treasury will share the remit instructions; we’ll keep the Net45 effective date aligned to the renewal start date (2027-07-01).
